scripts.build: pnpm --dir iaminfra/cms build && pnpm --dir frontend build && node scripts/sync-auth-portal.mjs && pnpm --dir backend build
scripts.deploy: pnpm --dir frontend build && node scripts/sync-auth-portal.mjs && pnpm --dir backend deploy
scripts.db:migrate:identity: npx wrangler d1 execute legendary-os-cms --remote --file=migrations/0001_identity_core.sql -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:identity:local: npx wrangler d1 execute legendary-os-cms --local --file=migrations/0001_identity_core.sql -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply legendary-os-cms --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply legendary-os-cms --local -c wrangler.jsonc
